what_happened: The agent logged the rejection of the "tokens loaded per class of work" job as the flaky batch-ordering test failing a third unrelated job. That was wrong. The retry had been made "drain-safe", so the change itself broke the batch-ordering test. The agent judged from the test name and did not check whether the change touched drain behaviour. No job work was judged here; the error was in the agent's diagnosis and log entry.
cause: A person or agent reports on state without resolving what it refers to, and Athena does not guard it. Here the state was the cause of a test failure. The agent attributed it from the test name and a remembered flakiness pattern. Athena gives no check that ties a failure claim to the job's diff and the failed check's output. The only guard is the agent's own habit of reading the records first.
other_causes: A known flaky test creates a prior that makes a repeat attribution feel safe.
The retry's wording ('drain-safe') signalled the change touched drain behaviour, but nothing connected it to the failing test.
open_hypotheses: Whether the batch-ordering test is also flaky on its own is not shown; the fields only say this failure was caused by the change.
Whether the two earlier rejections attributed to the same test were also caused by those jobs is not known.
prevention: Add a default for anyone logging or reporting a rejection cause. Before calling a failed check flaky or unrelated, read the job's diff and the failed check's output. Compare the files and behaviour the change touches with what the test covers. Also check whether the test failed on the base. State the cause only after that comparison. If it cannot be done, say the cause is unchecked.
proposed_request: Add a default to Athena's defaults set for anyone who logs, reports or queues work from a rejection or failed check. Before attributing a failed test to flakiness or to an unrelated cause, they must read the job's diff and the failed check's output and confirm whether the change touches the behaviour the test covers. If they have not, they must say the cause is unchecked rather than naming one. Keep the entry short, with the first sentence stating the rule, and keep the reader set within its token room. Update the budget figure recorded in docs/system-facts.md if the size changes. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.
